summary: Completed backend and frontend testing for Latency Correction System. All 22 backend API tests passed. Frontend Latency tab in Settings page working correctly with mode switching, effective buffers display, and timing accuracy stats.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Latency Correction System fully tested. Key features: 1) Three modes: AUTO (default, learns from trades), MANUAL (fixed offset), DISABLED (no correction). 2) Per-timeframe buffers (5s: 2.5s, 15s: 3.0s, 30s: 3.5s, 1m: 4.0s, 2m: 5.0s). 3) Frontend Latency tab in Settings accessible via sidebar Settings click. 4) All API endpoints tested: /api/latency/status, /api/latency/set-mode, /api/latency/set-manual-offset, /api/latency/record-timing-feedback, /api/latency/reset

backend_endpoints: GET /api/latency/status - Returns mode, offsets, effective buffers, accuracy stats
POST /api/latency/set-mode - Switches between auto, manual, disabled modes
POST /api/latency/set-manual-offset - Sets manual offset and switches to manual mode
POST /api/latency/record-timing-feedback - Records timing feedback for auto-correction
POST /api/latency/reset - Resets all latency settings to defaults
frontend_features: Settings page Latency tab displays correctly
Manual offset slider shows correct range (-5s to +5s)
Effective Timing Buffers display correct values per mode
Timing Accuracy section shows per-timeframe stats
Toast notifications appearing on mode change
